The pinned subset types lc.role.food as a LiquidMixture, so this binding does not extend to heating a vessel that holds no liquid.

lc:move_change_location is a general relocation sense and its self_mover role expects the agent to be what moves. Here the agent moves a liquid, so the binding is a specialization rather than a direct reading of the predicate.
Mixing is not implied by relocation. What happens when two liquids meet is computed by mechanism.liquid.pour.
